plc.title: PLC Programming for Beginners
plc.description: Learn the basics of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programming from scratch. This course covers fundamental concepts, Ladder Logic programming language, and practical applications.
plc.fullDesc: This comprehensive course qualifies you to understand and program PLC systems widely used in industry. You will learn through theoretical lessons, practical exercises, and interactive simulation.

power.title: Power Electronics
power.description: Explore the world of power electronics from transformers and converters to motor control systems. A comprehensive course for engineers and technicians.
power.fullDesc: An in-depth course in power electronics covering transformers, rectifiers, inverters, and speed control systems. Suitable for electrical engineers and technicians.

robotics.title: Robotics & ARM
robotics.description: Enter the world of advanced robotics and learn robot arm programming and ARM processors. An advanced course for mechanical engineers.
robotics.fullDesc: An advanced course in robotics and ARM processors. You will learn robot mechanics, sensors, motors, and industrial arm programming.

about.title: About
